welcome.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard ANA. We are delighted to have you with us today.

door_close.text: Cabin attendants, arm doors and cross check.

safety_demo.text: We will now begin the ANA safety video. Please watch the screens carefully.

takeoff_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare for departure.

climb_service.text: We will begin our inflight service shortly. Thank you for flying with ANA.

descent.text: We have started our descent. Please return to your seats and fasten your seatbelt.

turbulence.text: Ladies and gentlemen, due to expected turbulence, please return to your seats and fasten your seatbelts immediately.

landing_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare for landing.

arrival_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare the cabin for arrival.

deboarding.text: Thank you for flying with ANA today. Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop.

welcome.text: 女士们先生们，欢迎乘坐中国东方航空公司航班。请您系好安全带，收起小桌板。

door_close.text: 乘务组，舱门滑梯预位，交叉检查。

safety_demo.text: 现在播放安全演示，请注意观看。

climb_service.text: 我们将为您提供餐饮服务，感谢您选乘东航航班。

descent.text: 飞机即将下降，请回到座位坐好，系好安全带。

turbulence.text: 女士们先生们，由于预计有颠簸，请立即回到座位并系好安全带。

deboarding.text: 感谢您选乘东航航班，请等待飞机完全停稳后再起身。

welcome.text: 女士們先生們，歡迎乘搭國泰航空航班。請您繫好安全帶，收起小桌板，並確保手提行李妥善放置於頭頂行李艙或座椅底下。Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard Cathay Pacific. Please fasten your seatbelt, stow your tray table, and ensure your carry-on baggage is stored in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you.

door_close.text: 乘務員，艙門預位，交叉檢查。Cabin crew, arm doors and cross check.

safety_demo.text: 現在播放安全示範短片，請您留意觀看，即使您是經常乘機的旅客。We will now show you a safety video. Please watch carefully, even if you are a frequent flyer.

takeoff_prep.text: 乘務員，請就座，準備起飛。Cabin crew, please be seated for takeoff.

climb_service.text: 女士們先生們，我們將為您開始機上服務，感謝您選乘國泰航空。Ladies and gentlemen, we will shortly begin our inflight service. Thank you for choosing Cathay Pacific.

descent.text: 女士們先生們，本機即將開始下降。請回到座位，繫好安全帶，收起小桌板及調直椅背。Ladies and gentlemen, we have begun our descent. Please return to your seat, fasten your seatbelt, stow your tray table, and return your seat to the upright position.

turbulence.text: 女士們先生們，本機正在經歷氣流，請立即回到座位並繫好安全帶。Ladies and gentlemen, we are experiencing turbulence. Please return to your seat and fasten your seatbelt immediately.

landing_prep.text: 乘務員，請做好著陸準備。Cabin crew, prepare for landing.

arrival_prep.text: 乘務員，請準備客艙到達。Cabin crew, prepare the cabin for arrival.

deboarding.text: 女士們先生們，感謝您今日選乘國泰航空。請等候飛機完全停定後方可起身，並注意頭頂行李艙內的物品。希望下次旅途中再為您服務，再見。Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for flying with Cathay Pacific today. Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop and watch for items in the overhead bins. We hope to welcome you on board again soon. Goodbye.
